SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Minor damage to roofs, siding, and trees is possible. Hail

building.

killers. Remember, if you can hear thunder, you are close enough to
be struck by lightning.

Torrential rainfall is occurring with this storm, and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

afternoon.

feet on 10/29/1975.

properties.description:

Florida...

Alafia River At Lithia affecting Hillsborough County.

Horse Creek Near Arcadia at SR 72 affecting DeSoto County.

...The Flood Warning is cancelled for the following rivers in
Florida...

County.

the Alafia River At Lithia and Horse Creek Near Arcadia at SR 72 due
to recent heavy rainfall. The Little Manatee River At Wimauma at US
301 and Manatee River Near Myakka Head at SR 64 are no longer
forecast to reach Minor Flood Stage.

* WHERE...Alafia River at Lithia .

* WHEN...From this evening to late Saturday night.

of County Road 640 are completely covered by water. One home begins
to flood.

- Bankfull stage is 13.0 feet.

tomorrow afternoon to a crest of 13.3 feet early Saturday
morning. It will then fall below flood stage late Saturday
evening.

feet on 08/26/1945.
